IN pursuance of the provisions of clause (3) of Article 348 of the Constitution, the Governor is
pleased to order the publication of the following English translation of notification no. 2661/IX-1–2022-
27T.A.-22, dated September 15, 2022:
No. 2661/IX-1–2022- 27T.A.-22
Dated Lucknow, September 15, 2022
WHEREAS notification no.747/IX-1-2022-27T.A.-22 dated July 15, 2022 was issued and published
in the Gazette on the same date with a view to invite objections and suggestions from general public with
respect to the inclusion of the areas specified in the Schedule below in the transitional area of Nagar
Panchayat Bisanda in district Banda as required by section 4 of the Uttar Pradesh Muncipalities Act, 1916
(U.P. Act no. 2 of 1916), hereinafter referred to as the said Act;
AND, WHEREAS, no objection or suggestion has been received within the stipulated time ;
NOW, THEREFORE, in exercise of the powers under clause (2) of Article 243-Q of the Constitution
read with sub-section (2) of section 3 of the Uttar Pradesh Muncipalities Act, 1916 (U.P. Act no. II of
1916), and in partial modification of notification no. 7657T/IX-1-74-33T(1)-72 dated March 7, 1975 and
591 RPH (Nagar Vikas-1)N.P Bisanda, Banda 2022 Data 7e

other previous notifications issued in this behalf, the Governor having regard to the population of the area,
the density of the population therein, the revenue generated for local administration, the percentage of
employment in non agricultural activities and the economic importance and such other factors is pleased to
include the areas specified in the Schedule below in the territorial area of Nagar Panchayat, Bisanda in
district Banda for the purposes of Part IX-A of the Constitution.
SCHEDULE
